title: RLS policy split into 4 named policies per table, not one per table
note: Functionally equivalent, but contradicts spec's singular-policy wording. Need single policy per table OR document the 4-policy split as an intentional pattern.

title: `current_tenant_id` does NOT populate `request.state.tenant_id`
evidence: apps/api/core/tenant_context.py:61-62 stores request.state.tenant = ctx (TenantContext object), not request.state.tenant_id
note: Spec mandates the FastAPI dep populates request.state.tenant_id specifically.

title: Exact Korean error message missing: '다른 테넌트 데이터에 접근할 수 없습니다'
evidence: apps/api/core/security.py:81-146 uses 7 different Korean messages; the spec string never appears in code
note: Spec mandates this exact message for cross-tenant policy violation. Need a new AuthError variant + raise site for tenant_id mismatch.

title: Helper signature deviates from spec
evidence: apps/api/core/service_role.py:57-66 uses kw-only args + async context manager instead of positional (reason, actor_id, action) wrapper
note: Audit-first guarantee preserved, but API shape differs. Either change to spec OR document the deviation as an intentional async-friendly pattern.

title: Test seeds 1 user per tenant, not 2
evidence: tests/rls/conftest.py:104-122 inserts 2 users total (1 per tenant)

title: Test does NOT use `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_settings`
note: Logically equivalent (set of tenant_ids == {tenant_a}) but explicitly deviates from spec wording.

title: service_role audit-before-write test uses mocks, not a real DB query
note: Spec requires assertion that audit row is present in audit_logs immediately before the privileged write. Mock-based test does not satisfy this.
